summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes heavily-obfuscated sibling bundle
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime (pinned to v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases), extracts it, chmods it 0755, and then execFileSyncs the downloaded Bun binary with a sibling file math_init.js as its argument, running with the installer's user privileges at npm install time. math_init.js is a 727KB opaque payload marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`, obfuscated with a rotating string-array decoder (`function WV8StW(...)`) and hex-named identifiers. setup.mjs itself is written in obfuscator.io style with hex-named variables (`_0x488df8`, `_0x19328d`) and property-lookup indirection objects that wrap trivial calls, concealing the install-time behavior. The package presents as a Vue UI-component library, which has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime and execute obfuscated code at install. Using Bun to run the payload also bypasses Node-based static analyzers of lifecycle scripts. Any machine running `npm install` of this version executes the obfuscated math_init.js under Bun with the installer's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
